app.title: PlantUML Studio
app.subtitle: Fully offline UML editor
toolbar.formalismHint: Applies the shared formalism to every diagram, including hand-written ones. Turn off to render the source as-is.
template.confirmReplace: Replace the editor content with this template? Unsaved changes will be lost.
assistant.title: Diagram creation assistant
assistant.willReplace: The current editor content will be replaced.
derive.hint: Produce sequence, communication and analysis class diagrams from the open use case diagram.
derive.title: Derive from the use case diagram
derive.notAUseCase: The editor content is not recognised as a use case diagram: at least one actor and one use case are needed.
derive.notDerivableWhy: These diagrams need information the use case diagram does not carry.
derive.needProject: Open a project to save several files.
derive.saved: {count} derived diagrams saved to the project.
filetree.empty: No project open. Use "Open project" to pick a folder containing your .puml files.
preview.empty: Write some PlantUML code to see the diagram appear here.
preview.editHint: Drag diagram elements with the mouse; a package carries its contents along. The source is left untouched.
preview.optimizeHint: Look for a more readable layout: fewer crossings, touching arrows and elements cut through. The source is left untouched.
toast.layoutArranged: Actors arranged into columns ({count}); {after} defects left.
toast.layoutAlreadyGood: Layout already optimal: no move improves it.
toast.layoutTooLarge: Diagram too large for automatic optimisation.
errors.title: Rendering error
errors.redundantAssociation: "{actor}" inherits from "{ancestor}": its arrow to "{useCase}" is redundant — inheritance already grants it.
env.title: Environment diagnostics
env.blocked: Diagrams cannot be generated until these issues are resolved.
analyze.hint: Describe the system in plain English; the application extracts actors and their use cases.
analyze.title: Analyse a textual description
analyze.placeholder:
Describe the system in short sentences.

Online bookstore
A visitor can browse the catalogue and create an account.
The registered customer inherits from the visitor.
The registered customer can place an order.
The payment gateway is an external service.
analyze.example.story: As a warehouse clerk, I want to prepare a shipment.
analyze.example.can: A visitor can browse the catalogue and create an account.
analyze.example.allow: The system shall allow the customer to pay an order.
analyze.example.inherits: The registered customer inherits from the visitor.
analyze.example.external: The payment gateway is an external service.
analyze.kind.internalUseCase: Use cases without a direct actor
analyze.ignoredHint: Nothing was extracted from them: no actor or action recognised. Rephrase them as short sentences, or type them into the assistant by hand.
analyze.nothing: Type a description: actors and their use cases will appear here, each with the sentence that produced it.
analyze.proposalOnly: A proposal to check: nothing is written before you validate it in the assistant.
analyze.needActor: No actor was recognised: state who does what.
